correctness.rationale: Direct spectral projectors C,P,R for Q=D^-1A-I give eigenvalues 0,-1/2,-3/2. The nested binary-coarea formula reduces Gini operator norm of P to cut indicators. Independent completion of split pairs reduces to all-full/all-empty pair cuts without increasing input variation in expectation. Exactly one full pair gives the maximum ratio 2(m²−1)/(m(2m−1)); its signs simultaneously norm bI+(a-b)P, proving equality at every t. Exact forward differences give unique size m=4 maximizer; factorization proves strict contraction. Exact-rational checker verified these matrix identities, orbit inequalities, witnesses and signed inputs. Finite checks are supporting evidence only.

value.rationale: An exact, self-contained all-m, all-t stability law for a widely used random-walk diffusion on a natural hub-connected graph family, in a natural all-pair dispersion seminorm. Its surprising unique finite worst size m=4 and strict Gini contraction despite potentially different edge-norm behavior quantify a meaningful stability distinction. The sharp finite projection norm and random split-pair completion are structural rather than only computed constants.
